featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie made the case for model stratification in enterprise AI. Frontier models (GPT-5.5, Opus) handle high-value tasks; once a task is reliably solved, it gets peeled off to cheaper models for steady-state runs. The layer that efficiently routes workloads to the right model — cost-optimizing while still succeeding — becomes the new hard problem and a strong position. He also flagged what the market gets wrong about AI eating enterprise software: building software got easier, but the bulk of enterpris…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周连发几条，核心是企业 AI 的「模型分层」判断。他认为未来一两年用例必然分化：前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Opus）干高价值任务（编程、生命科学、合同与财务流程），一旦某个任务能被可靠完成，就「剥离」到更便宜的模型上常态化跑。由此真正变值钱的，是能把工作负载智能路由到正确模型、同时控成本又不掉链子的「Agent 编排层」——这会是 AI Agent 的新硬问题。另一条他点破了市场对「AI 吃掉企业软件」的误读：AI 让写软件变容易了，但企业软件公司的成本大头在 GTM（顾问式销售、实施集成），AI 不仅没减少这块需求，反而因为产品越来越多、买家越来越难选，把「可发现性和差异化」变成了最难的部分。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code
featured.summaryEn: Claude Code lead Boris Cherny shared five tips for running Opus autonomously for hours/days: 1) use auto mode for permissions so Claude doesn't stop for approval; 2) use dynamic workflows to orchestrate hundreds/thousands of agents; 3) use `/goal` or `/loop` to keep it going until done; 4) run Claude Code in the cloud so you can close your laptop; 5) make sure Claude can self-verify end to end — Chrome extension for web, iOS/Android sim MCP for mobile, a way to spin up the full service for backend work.
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 给出「让 Opus 自主跑数小时/数天」的五条实操建议：1）权限用 auto 模式，别让 Claude 反复求批准；2）用 dynamic workflows，让 Claude 编排成百上千个 agent 完成任务；3）用 `/goal` 或 `/loop` 推着它干到完；4）把 Claude Code 跑在云端，关上笔记本也不停（桌面/手机 app 最省事）；5）务必给 Claude 端到端自我验证的手段——网页用 Chrome 扩展、移动端用 iOS/Android 模拟器 MCP、后端能拉起完整服务。这是「设计 loop 而非逐句 prompt」这波趋势的具体落地清单。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw's Peter Steinberger crystallized the week's "loops" theme in one line: "Here's your monthly reminder that you shouldn't be prompting coding agents anymore. You should be designing loops that prompt your agents." It became the unofficial slogan of the week, riffed on by several builders.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 的 Peter Steinberger 一句话把本周的「loops」主题钉死了：「每月例行提醒——你不该再给编程 agent 写 prompt 了，你该设计那些去 prompt 你 agent 的 loop。」这条几乎成了本期 builder 圈的口号，多位 builder（Peter Yang、Nikunj、Sam Altman）都在借它玩梗。

items.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru punctured a common myth: training data isn't low-skill grunt work. The data that advances the frontier is the opposite — labs need data for high-economic-value tasks, and most of those (outside SWE) have little documentation, being complex domain knowledge built over years across disconnected legacy tools. That's why we have SWE agents but not knowledge-work agents yet. Companies like Mercor creating this data are doing high-leverage, high-skill, deeply underappreciated work.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 戳破一个常见误解：训练数据不是低技能的体力活。推动模型前沿的数据恰恰相反——实验室需要的是「高经济价值任务」的数据，而这类任务（SWE 之外）大多缺乏文档、是多年积累的复杂领域知识，还横跨互不相通的遗留工具。这正是「为什么我们有了 SWE agent，却还没有知识工作 agent」的根因。他点名 Mercor 这类造数据的公司在做极高杠杆、极高技能的工作，对推进 AI 至关重要，却被严重低估。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared a striking number: Vercel AI Gateway recovers over 1T tokens a month on average — much like Stripe recovers revenue via smart retries on failed payments. It does this with zero markup over the labs, adding redundancy, zero-data-retention enforcement, observability, usage APIs, and caps. A useful data point on where gateway-layer value lives: reliability and governance, not resale.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 晒了个有意思的数字：Vercel AI Gateway 平均每月「找回」超过 1 万亿 token——类比 Stripe 用智能重试找回失败支付的收入。它对实验室零加价（zero markup），靠的是加冗余、强制零数据留存、可观测性、用量 API 和上限等能力。对企业 AI 基建选型是个参考点：网关层的价值不在转售，而在可靠性与治理。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures Partner
items.summaryEn: Investor Nikunj Kothari noted a vibe shift: in just weeks the mood went from tokenmaxxing/token anxiety to tokenoptimizing. His hot take: companies should still give employees copious token budget to stay at the frontier and explore the edges — otherwise it's too easy to fall back to "doing things how they've always been done." A nice tension against the cost-stratification view.
items.insightZh: 投资人 Nikunj Kothari 观察到一个有意思的「氛围转向」：短短几周，行业情绪从 tokenmaxxing / token 焦虑变成了 tokenoptimizing。但他抛出一个偏热的观点：公司仍应给员工充裕的 token 预算，让他们待在前沿、探索所有边角；否则太容易退回到「一直以来都这么干」的旧路径上。这与 Aaron Levie 的成本分层视角形成有趣的张力——省 token 与探索前沿之间如何平衡。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP（前 Dropbox CTO）
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal, who's been through two IPOs (Meta and Dropbox), offered a counter-narrative: vast wealth amplifies deeper desires rather than creating new ones. The "early employees buy mansions and chill" story is only part of it — for many, liquidity is a chance to do crazier, wackier things: start and fund new ventures, keeping Silicon Valley's loop going. He expects a wave of newly-liquid people in the coming months. Onwards.
items.insightZh: 经历过 Meta、Dropbox 两次 IPO 的 Aditya Agarwal 写了段反主流叙事的观察：巨额财富放大的是更深层的欲望，而非凭空创造新欲望。「早期员工赚大钱、买豪宅、去海滩」只是部分人——对很多人来说，流动性反而是去做更疯、更野的事的机会：创办新东西、资助新东西，让硅谷那个疯狂的 loop 继续转。他预判未来几个月会有一大批人手握流动性，「往前冲」。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux announced a new "big button": over the next 100 days, they'll pick one person per day doing impressive or incredibly useful work with Codex and grant them 10X usage limits for a month to see what they build. First one tomorrow — a community experiment incentivized via compute quota.
items.insightZh: OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布了个「大按钮」玩法：接下来 100 天，每天选一位用 Codex 做出令人印象深刻或极其有用工作的人，给他一个月 10 倍用量额度，看看他能玩出什么。明天开始第一位。本质是一次用「算力配额」激励的社区共创实验。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator CEO
items.summaryEn: YC CEO Garry Tan's most notable line: "Educating people on how to use the AI tools has become a serious bottleneck." The diffusion bottleneck isn't the model — it's human onboarding. This rhymes with Madhu Guru's "knowledge work lacks documentation" and Levie's "diffusion is slower than people think." He also noted his GBrain v0.42.30 can now summarize how your thinking has changed over time.
items.insightZh: YC CEO Garry Tan 连发几条，最值得注意的判断：「教人怎么用 AI 工具，已经成了一个严重的瓶颈。」——能力扩散的卡点不在模型，而在人的上手。这与 Madhu Guru「知识工作缺文档」、Aaron Levie「扩散比想象慢」的判断在同一条线上：技术跑在前面，组织与人没跟上。他还提到自研的 GBrain v0.42.30 现在能总结「你的思考随时间如何变化」。

items.title: Claude Managed Agents 新增「Dreaming」、Outcomes 与多 Agent 编排
items.summaryEn: Anthropic shipped three notable capabilities for Claude Managed Agents. Dreaming (research preview): a scheduled process that reviews past sessions and memory stores, extracts patterns, and curates memory so agents self-improve — surfacing things a single agent can't see (recurring mistakes, shared team preferences, converged workflows) and restructuring memory to stay high-signal. It can update automatically or with human review. Harvey saw ~6x higher completion rates. Outcomes: you write a rubric for success, and a separate grader evaluates output in its own context window (unbiased by the agent's reasoning), pinpointing fixes for another pass. Internal tests showed up to +10 points task success, +8.4% on docx and +10.1% on pptx generation. Multiagent orchestration: a lead agent delegates pieces to specialist subagents with their own model/prompt/tools, working in parallel on a shared…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 给 Claude Managed Agents 上了三个值得关注的能力。Dreaming（研究预览）：一个定时进程，回顾 agent 的历史 session 和记忆库，提取模式、整理记忆，让 agent 随时间自我改进——它能看见单个 agent 看不见的东西（反复犯的错、团队共享的偏好、收敛出的工作流），并重构记忆保持「高信噪比」。可设为自动更新，或人工审核后落地。Harvey 用它后任务完成率提升约 6 倍。Outcomes：你写一份「什么算成功」的评分标准（rubric），一个独立的 grader 在自己的上下文窗口里评判输出（不受 agent 推理过程影响），不达标就指出问题让 agent 重做。内测里任务成功率最多提升 10 个百分点，文件生成 docx +8.4%、pptx +10.1%。多 Agent 编排：lead agent 把大活拆给各有自己模型/prompt/工具的专家 subagent，在共享文件系统上并行干活，全程在 Claude Console 可追溯。Netflix 平台团队用它并行分析数百个 build 的日志，只浮出真正反复出现、值得处理的模式。
